messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Detected spike of GPU OOMs on serving-cluster-03 (prefill path). Paging oncall @jordan — cluster/gpu-03 showing repeated container restarts.
jordan: I'm on it, joining. Any customer impact reported yet?
mira: Seeing ~20 restarts across gpu-03 pool in last 12m. Error pattern: OOM during prefill for long-context requests to model redwood/70b. Some streamed responses drop mid-token.
jordan: logs?
mira: ```
[2026-03-16T22:10:12Z] python[23145]: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-16T22:10:13Z] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 23145 (python) total-vm:...
Container restarted by kubelet
```
devon: Prefill window for those requests is huge — clients sending very long prompts (80k+ tokens). Prefetch alloc blows past kvcache budget.
eli: Can we route long-context requests to coldmodel variants or throttle prefill concurrency?
jordan: Quick mitigation plan: 1) throttle prefill concurrency on gpu-03 pool 2) enable routing to fallback smaller model for requests > 48k tokens 3) trim/evict kvcache for affected pods 4) notify support for customer updates.
mira: Applying eviction and reducing prefill concurrency now (patching autoscaler config).
support-lead: Customers C and D reported timeouts; capturing details and preparing a short customer advisory.
devon: Rolling a hot-config: PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS  = 65536 -> 32768 for the cluster. Command: ```bash
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/api/runtime/config -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' -d '{"prefill_max_tokens":32768, "prefill_concurrency_limit":2}'
```
mira: Patch applied on gpu-03 at ~22:12UTC and restarted pods gracefully. Restart count decreased.
eli: Also put a quick routing rule: if request.tokens > 48000 -> route to model:redwood/70b-coldmodel (lower memory footprint).
jordan: Confirming metrics: OOM events went from ~12/min to 0 within 3 minutes after mitigation. Error rate for long-session traffic back to baseline.
support-lead: I'll send customer update: "We identified GPU memory exhaustion from unusually large prefill requests; traffic temporarily routed and config tightened. Service restored, postmortem to follow."
devon: Follow-ups (assigned to infra/serving): - Add gateway reject for >100k tokens, - Add prefill token distribution alert, - Investigate kvcache eviction heuristics for long-session fairness.
mira: Captured heap and kvcache dumps for tech postmortem.
oncall-bot: Handoff: Escalation to weekday lead @devon for postmortem and long-term remediation.
jordan: Handoff acknowledged. Preparing incident notes and will attach metrics/timelines. Thanks all for fast response :thumbsup:
support-lead: I'll post the customer advisory in #customer-notify in 30m.
eli: Suggest adding rate limit by effective token-cost (prefill tokens * model_factor) to prevent similar blast from a single client.
jordan: Agreed — adding to action items. Closing live mitigation; monitoring open for 1h.
